title: Steps
summary: Where a person is in an ordered process of their own: a list of steps, each a marker (number or dot) and a label joined by a progress line, drawn as a row, a column or a «Step N of M» line by its own width. Passive by default; navigation makes the reachable steps buttons.

template.description: Template variant name for SfBaseElement external templates.

root-class.description: Classes added to the root element the component draws.

root-style.description: Inline style declarations set on the root element the component draws, custom properties included.

size.description: The rung: 1, or 1/2 for dense cards and panels. The marker is the rung's text line (24 at 1, 20 at 1/2 on a desktop).

marker.description: What marks a step: its number (a check when done, «!» on an error), or a dot for a passive status and dense cards. The same three shapes either way: filled done, filled with a ring current, empty ahead.

layout.description: auto: a row while the steps fit their own width on one line, else a column (label and a second line); under 20rem of its own width the count line «Шаг N из M · label» over sf-progress-bar. row, column and count draw that layout always; an explicit row wider than its place scrolls inside itself.

navigation.description: Empty: the steps are a passive list, nothing is pressed. visited: a step behind current, or one done, skipped or failed, is a button that moves there; free: every step not disabled is. As in sf-wizard; the current step is never a button.

error-step.description: The former way to mark one step failed (sf-steps 1.3 and before): read until 2027-01-01 and noted in SF.deprecations. Today an item says state "error".

separator-icon.description: Former: the glyph between steps (chevron_right). Since 1.4.0 steps are joined by a line and the setting is ignored; noted in SF.deprecations, removed after 2027-01-01.

completed-label.description: The word a screen reader hears after a done step's label. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Completed" in English).

current-label.description: The word a screen reader hears after a current step's label. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Current" in English).

ahead-label.description: The word a screen reader hears after a not yet started step's label. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Not started" in English).

error-label.description: The word a screen reader hears after a failed step's label. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Error" in English).

skipped-label.description: The word a screen reader hears after a skipped step's label. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Skipped" in English).

running-label.description: The word a screen reader hears after a running step's label. Empty: the text of the page's language ("In progress" in English).

count-label.description: The count line's position, {n} and {count} filled in. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Step {n} of {count}" in English).

current.description: The current step, from 0. Equal to the number of steps: all are done and none is current.

aria-label.description: Empty: the text of the page's language ("Steps" in English).

items.description: The steps in order, as JSON: {label, text?, state?, disabled?}. text is the second line a column shows (a date, a time, «optional», the reason of an error). state is the step's own: done, skipped, running or error, or ahead for a step before current that was never done; without it the place decides (before current: done, at current: current, after: ahead). completed and default are the former words of done and ahead, read until 2027-01-01.

goToStep.summary: Moves current to the step at index, clamped to the list; refuses a disabled or the current step. It moves whatever navigation says (navigation is what a person may press). Sends no sf-steps-change: that is a person's press.

setState.summary: Writes each key as its kebab-case attribute; an array (items) is written as JSON. false, null, undefined or empty removes the attribute, true sets it empty.

onStepChange.summary: Adds a listener for sf-steps-change; the handler is called with (current, detail, event). Ignores a non-function handler.

accessibility.focus: Passive by default: no step is focusable. With navigation, each reachable step is a native button reached by Tab, with the shared focus-visible indicator. The current item has aria-current=step; every item carries its state word for a screen reader.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-steps to show where a person is in an ordered process they go through (checkout, a setup, a form in steps, an order's status). Not for a server job (sf-progress-run) or tasks done in any order (a task list).
do_not: Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not move host data or access decisions into the component
